tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List every city the Max Eats Out guide covers, with how many venues each holds. Coverage is uneven BY DESIGN — it follows where the author has actually eaten — so call this before assuming a city is covered rather than searching a city that is not in the guide and reporting no results.
